exposure: Treatment with amoxicillin and clavulanic acid
outcome: CPE carriage in newborns (30 minutes after delivery)
cohort: The study included 197 parturients and 203 newborns from Franceville hospital's maternity and neonatology wards.
finding: The study revealed a 4.6% CPE carriage rate in mothers, no CPE carriage in newborns at 30 minutes post-delivery, but an incidence density of 0.49 CPE-associated bloodstream infections per 100 newborns, with significant environmental CPE contamination clonally linked to maternal isolates.
cross-section timing: Rectal swabs from parturients before delivery and from newborns 30 minutes after birth; environmental samples collected during the study period (February 22nd to June 20th, 2022).
